verdict.rationale: Bevy publishes migration guides for every release (bevy-docs-15) and community reports confirm each version bump requires code changes with published guides (bevy-comm-13), but there is no evidence of a formal deprecation policy (e.g., deprecation warnings before removal, semver stability guarantees) — community feedback instead describes breaking changes as the norm rather than a managed deprecation cycle (bevy-comm-10). missing for 10: documented deprecation policy/semver guarantees, evidence of deprecation warnings prior to removal, stability commitments beyond migration guides.
